meaning:
ἀρχι-ποίμην, -ενος, ὁ
[in Sm.: 4Ki.3:4 * ;]
found on an Egyptian mummy label (Deiss., LAE, 97 ff.; cf. MM, see word); used by modem Greeks of tribal chiefs; chief shepherd. of Christ, 1Pe.5:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
